description: Describes what is in an image in about one second: pass an https URL or base64 and ask anything about it, from a one-line caption to reading a sign. Pairs with the rest of the chain: describe an image, translate the description, then have it read aloud. You are only charged if the description is delivered. No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

image.description: The image, as base64. Use this or url.

max_tokens.description: Length limit of the answer, 16-512. Default 128.

prompt.description: What to ask about the image. Default: a one-sentence description.

url.description: https URL of the image to describe. Use this or image.

name: ai_image_describe
title: Describe what is in an image
